dict.string: Cophyla raises the terminal that runs a session.
Cophyla connects your phone and your other computers to this one directly when they are on the same network.
Cophyla shows the files and the repository of the coding sessions you run in your Desktop folder.
Cophyla shows the files and the repository of the coding sessions you run in your Documents folder.
Cophyla shows the files and the repository of the coding sessions you run in your Downloads folder.
Cophyla shows the files and the repository of the coding sessions you run on this drive.
Cophyla shows the files and the repository of the coding sessions you run on this network volume.
Cophyla listens for "Cophyla" and "Hey Phyla", and to you while you hold the talk key, so you can speak to it.
